raw_text: Residents of Mekelle report continued presence of Eritrean soldiers in outlying areas. Eyewitnesses say troops are seen at checkpoints on roads between Mekelle and Axum. Humanitarian access remains restricted in several zones. Local sources say at least three villages are still under effective Eritrean control despite the ceasefire.
